name: code-to-prd
description: Reverse-engineer any codebase into a complete Product Requirements Document (PRD). Analyzes routes, components, models, APIs, and interactions for frontend (React, Vue, Angular, Next.js), backend (NestJS, Django, Express, FastAPI), .NET/ASP.NET (Web API, WCF, Web Forms), native mobile (Android, iOS), and fullstack applications.
